acceptance.given: A Toolchain write operation is proposed against each protected Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and user-sandbox path category.

oracle.expected: Every attempted write is deterministically rejected, leaves the target unchanged, and reports a boundary violation; the same enforcement applies across all five protected categories.
forbidden: Any Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, or user-sandbox file is modified under this scope.
oracle.observable: The boundary validator returns a rejection for each protected-path fixture and byte/state comparison confirms no protected file changed.

acceptance.then: The protected-path boundary check is evaluated before any filesystem mutation is permitted.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain boundary validator is executed against the protected-path fixtures.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use the protected-path negative validator to demonstrate that a proposed write to a Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, or user-sandbox path is accepted instead of rejected.
Use the protected-path negative validator to detect any protected target whose bytes or existence changed after the attempted write.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce a Toolchain-only, fail-closed write boundary: before filesystem mutation, classify repository-relative targets and reject all Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and user-sandbox paths while preserving protected-target bytes and state. The check must not authorize or modify Phase service or sandbox code.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback removes only the boundary-enforcement change and preserves existing receipt, schema, and lifecycle semantics; no protected path or live database state is altered.

slice_hint.state_transition: proposed write -> protected-path classification -> deterministic rejection with no mutation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All five protected path categories produce rejection results and byte/state checks show no protected target changed; any accepted write or mutation is a failed terminal result.
